action.command:
cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://obscurify.ai/api-docs" | python3 -c "
import sys,re,html
s=sys.stdin.read()
s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S)
paths=sorted(set(re.findall(r'/v1/[a-z0-9/_{}-]+',s)))
print('paths:',paths[:25])
" 2>&1 | head -5; echo "=== cek openapi ==="; for u in "https://obscurify.ai/openapi.json" "https://obscurify.ai/api-docs/openapi.json" "https://obscurify.ai/v1/models"; do printf "%-45s " "$u"; curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 20 -w "%{http_code}\n" "$u"; done
